signals.title: Puppet Show: Thumbelina (Палечка)
signals.reason: Delightful morning puppet adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's classic fairy tale, perfectly paced for a 4-year-old.

signals.title: Circus Arlekino in Plovdiv (Цирк Арлекино)
signals.location: Trakia District (opposite Forum Shopping Center), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Classic big-top family circus featuring trained animals, clown skits, giant bubbles, and interactive fun for young kids.
signals.note: Confirmed on Circus Arlekino official Facebook page for September 26 – October 18, 2026.

signals.title: DECATHLON Color Run & Family Sports Fest
signals.location: Decathlon Grounds, 43A Osvobozhdenie Blvd, Trakia, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Fun non-competitive 5 km family run with playful color stations and open-air activities suited for energetic preschoolers.

signals.title: Kyuchuk Paris Neighborhood Festival (Празникът на Кючука)
signals.location: Studenets Park (Raycho Kirkov Park), South District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Relaxed outdoor park festival featuring children's games, traditional crafts, farm treats, and music in a shady setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and plovdiv-news.bg for September 25–27, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Book Alley (Алея на книгата)
signals.reason: Pedestrian open-air book alley with children's literature pavilions and cozy outdoor reading corners.
signals.note: Confirmed on impressio.bg for September 28 – October 4, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Doctor Dolittle (Доктор Дулитъл)
signals.reason: Humorous, animal-filled stage adventure teaching empathy and listening in an engaging format for preschoolers.

signals.title: Musical Fantasy Show: Frozen Heart (Замръзналото сърце)
signals.reason: Colorful stage musical with fairy-tale characters, lively choreography, and recognizable songs for young fans.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.location: Aviation Museum, Krumovo (~15 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Open-air grounds packed with real aircraft and helicopters where a 4-year-old can safely run around and inspect big machines.

signals.title: Byala Reka Ecotrail Walk
signals.location: Near Kalofer (~50 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Safe and scenic walk along sturdy wooden bridges and railings over a mountain river, without dangerous steep cliffs.

signals.title: Mustafa Algiyadi – Stand Up Comedy in English
signals.reason: Solo English-language stand-up comedy performance by international comedian Mustafa Algiyadi; fully accessible and squarely fits taste.

signals.title: Symphony Concert: New Conductors of Europe
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Classical orchestral symphonic performance by State Opera Plovdiv; purely musical and accessible without Bulgarian.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for September 26, 2026.

signals.title: 32nd Week of Contemporary Art: 'Bug in Reality' Exhibition
signals.location: City Art Gallery (Temporary Exhibition Halls), 15 Knyaz Alexander I St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Visual contemporary art exhibition exploring urban spaces and systemic themes by international and Bulgarian artists; visual medium right on the main pedestrian strip.
signals.note: Confirmed on bta.bg and visitplovdiv.com through October 2, 2026.

signals.title: GuitArt X Festival 2026 Opening Concert: Tu Le & Samuel Solomon
signals.location: First Studio of Radio Plovdiv, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Acoustic and classical guitar opening recital for the 10th edition of the international GuitArt festival; non-verbal performance.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and guitart.bg for October 1, 2026 at First Studio of Radio Plovdiv.

signals.title: Alley of the Book (Алея на книгата) Open-Air Market
signals.reason: Annual open-air literary and publishing fair spanning Central Square; books are mostly in Bulgarian with some foreign literature, creating a vibrant central market atmosphere.
signals.note: Confirmed on impressio.bg for September 28 – October 4, 2026.

signals.title: Introduction of Low Emission Zone 'Small Ring' in Central Plovdiv
signals.location: Central District / Small Ring Zone, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Plovdiv Municipality is introducing vehicular emission restrictions across central streets for the first time, impacting vehicle access and parking for non-compliant cars.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and marica.bg for October 1, 2026.

signals.title: Temporary Traffic Stoppages on Blvd. Shipka and Blvd. Tsar Simeon for Decathlon Color Run
signals.location: Blvd. Shipka & Blvd. Tsar Simeon (Trakia District), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Scheduled temporary street closures and public bus route diversions on major thoroughfares in Trakia due to a 5k sporting run.

signals.title: Cobblestone Repaving and Parking Disruptions on Prolet Street by Roman Stadium
signals.reason: Municipal street infrastructure overhaul replacing asphalt with paving blocks adjacent to the Roman Stadium, restricting downtown Blue Zone parking and access.
signals.note: Could not find specific corroborating source or municipal notice for cobblestone repaving on Prolet Street.

signals.title: Construction and Phased Opening of Retail Park Ostromila
signals.reason: New 4,600 sq. m commercial retail park between Ostromila and Kyuchuk Paris, expanding local shopping infrastructure.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg for retail park development on Dimitar Talev St.

signals.title: Plovdiv Airport Autumn/Winter Direct Scheduled Flights
signals.reason: Active direct international connections operating out of Plovdiv Airport to London Stansted, London Luton, and Milan Malpensa, offering local regional flight alternatives without traveling to Sofia.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdivairport.com official flight schedule.
